698571001.text: Illuga, can't you just, y'know, sneak up behind those monsters with me and BAM, take 'em all down?

698571002.text: I can act three times in a round, and there are only four monsters in total. I'll take three down, you just gotta handle the last one.

698571003.text: I can draw the monsters' attention from the front, but sneak attacks...

698571004.text: Hmm... Well, there isn't much we can do. Illuga's a "Lochknight" who chose the "Goblet of Justice."

698571005.text: Indeed. If Illuga were to strike from behind, he would be forced to become an "Oathbreaker Knight." A significant penalty would apply to all actions going forward.

698571006.text: Oof, that's not good. If we don't defeat all these monsters in one go, those explosives are going to blow us sky-high!

698571007.text: There's another way. I can use "Raging Torrent" to dash straight into the thick of it, then detonate the explosives...

698571008.text: No, no, that won't do at all! Your character would get "Wiped Out" that way! We finally managed to gather the party and have such a lovely time together. It would be such a shame if you were the only one who got "Wiped Out."

698571009.text: But if we don't do this, the "Character" that you've been playing for so long might get "Wiped Out" too, Miss Navia. Wouldn't that be worse?

698571010.text: I only just started playing, please don't—

698571011.text: Hrrrm... Wait, I've got another trick up my sleeve.

698571013.text: Uh-oh! That move was blocked too!

698571016.text: These pieces on the table, and the stuff you were saying just now — you're playing...

698571017.text: Ah! A savior has arrived! Right on time! Quick, quick, quick, come join us!

698571018.text: Clorinde, this doesn't count as violating the rules, right?

698571103.text: #If {M#he's}{F#she's} willing to join us. Oh, by the way, we're currently playing on "Easy Mode" to accommodate the newcomers.

698571104.text: #{NICKNAME}, would you like to continue the adventure with us? You definitely would, right?

698571301.text: Very well then. Let the game continue.

698571302.text: Ahem! "...Just when everyone was at their wit's end, a familiar voice rang out from behind them."

698571402.text: #By the way, {NICKNAME}, what are you doing here? Could it be that you heard our summons?

698571403.text: #(Hehe, that kinda makes {M#him}{F#her} sound like a summoned spirit... Well, not that {M#he}{F#she} doesn't fit the part, hehe...)

698571404.text: I—Indeed... You have called, and I must answer!

698571405.text: (Guess that means, "I was randomly dragged into this game!")

698571701.text: #({M#He's}{F#She's} really good at getting into character, as always...)

698571801.text: "Though the Marechaussee Hunters had much they wished to share with one another, at this moment, the joy of reunion must yield to the crisis at hand."

698571802.text: Now then, the combat round continues. You have the first turn.

698571803.text: Also, since we have a new member joining us, I'll be adding some "Dark Cards" to boost the enemies' various abilities.

698571804.text: #{NICKNAME} isn't a sudden addition, {M#he's}{F#she's} been traveling with us all along.

698571805.text: We've just, uh... parted for a short while, that's all! Totally normal!

698571806.text: Ah, I've already counted the "Dark Cards." You should start discussing your tactics.

698571808.text: #Anyway, let's stick to the original strategy. Now that we have {NICKNAME} with us, we have enough people.

698571809.text: Illuga and I will hold the line out front against the monsters' assault.

698571810.text: #Jahoda, {NICKNAME}, you circle around to the back and take 'em all down in one swoop.

698571811.text: Alright, leave it to me! Hehe, we "Masters of Qi" get huge damage boosts when attacking from behind.

698571901.text: Uh, but, hehe... Why are you a Chef? How's a Chef... gonna perform a sneak attack?

698571502.text: #By the way, {NICKNAME}, what are you doing here? Could it be that you heard our summons?

698571503.text: #(Hehe, that kinda makes {M#him}{F#her} sound like a summoned spirit... Well, not that {M#he}{F#she} doesn't fit the part, hehe...)

698571504.text: I—Indeed... You have called, and I must answer!

698571505.text: (Guess that means, "I was randomly dragged into this game!")

698571601.text: (As expected of the veteran player Miss Navia mentioned before, they got into character instantly...)

698572101.text: So that's how it is... These "Tabletop Troupe" games really are complicated... You gotta have a lot of imagination...

698572102.text: #Hmm... Coming up with a strategy already, huh? Nice work, {NICKNAME}. But let me say one more thing. Illuga, don't go charging in alone this time.

698572103.text: I understand. A "Lochknight"'s duty is to protect their companions and be their shield... Sorry, I always can't help myself...

698572104.text: Oh, don't worry about it. I can act three times in a round, so I'll definitely keep up with you. Just play however you want. Hehehe...

698572105.text: Alright, Illuga, we'll be counting on you!

698572106.text: Then I shall... use the skill attached to the Lochknight's shield: "Wrath of Righteousness"!

698572107.text: "The Lochknight raised their shield, chanting the knights' creed out loud. The monsters were completely captivated by the radiance of justice, and the fearless knight standing within that light."

698572108.text: "Meanwhile, the two companions lying in wait behind the foe seized this opportunity, preparing to launch their attack."

698572109.text: You take the first swing, I'll hit right after!

698572202.text: #"The Marechaussee Hunter's skills hadn't dulled with time. Nimbly {M#he}{F#she} leapt from the bushes and delivered a mighty blow to the enemy's head with {M#his}{F#her} frying pan."

698572203.text: "Though the frying pan might be ordinary, the Marechaussee Hunter was no ordinary Chef. The enemy let out a grunt before collapsing completely."

698573001.text: N—Nice! Okay. Next, I'll... Right. Gotta use "Swift as Wind" to close the distance, then use "Four Elements Strike" from behind...

698573101.text: *sigh* That didn't work at all! Ugh, okay, whatever, the monsters are charging at me anyway. I'll just stand, plant, and blow 'em away with "Four Elements Strike"...

698573201.text: Ack! That hurts! Ugh, who bit my leg... Huh, Ashru, what are you doing here?

698573203.text: Ah...! I—Is it this late already!? Oh no, oh no, I completely forgot the task that Boss Nef asked me to handle!

698573204.text: I'm sorry, I—I'm sorry, I—I—I can't play right now—

698573206.text: Ashru, wait for me! Hey, why are you running off so fast!

698573207.text: Well... It seems we'll have to end our game here for today.

698573208.text: Navia, put the monster sign back where it was, I saw that.

698572302.text: "The Marechaussee Hunter suddenly leapt out from the bushes, violently slamming the frying pan into the enemy."

698572303.text: "However, while the Marechaussee Hunter was no ordinary Chef, the frying pan was just an ordinary frying pan."

698572304.text: "As it struck the back of the enemy's head, it shattered into pieces. Stunned for a moment, the enemy turned around, glaring at the now unarmed Marechaussee Hunter."

698572402.text: "The Marechaussee Hunter deftly took out some cooking utensils and began to quickly prepare an exquisite, delicious meal."

698572403.text: #"Lured by the aroma, the enemies focused entirely on this feast in the making, completely overlooking the Marechaussee Hunter and {M#his}{F#her} companion."

698572502.text: "The Marechaussee Hunter deftly took out some cooking utensils and began cooking, quickly preparing a meal."

698572503.text: "Drawn by the sounds of cooking, the enemies stared in confusion at the Marechaussee Hunter preparing food, seemingly oblivious to the meal being prepared."

698572602.text: "The Marechaussee Hunter reached into their medicine box and skillfully concocted an anesthetic potion."

698572603.text: #"{M#He}{F#She} stealthily rolled the potion towards the enemies' feet. In an instant, the unsuspecting foes fell, unconscious."

698572702.text: #"The Marechaussee Hunter reached into their medicine box. But just as {M#he}{F#she} was about to prepare a potion, {M#he}{F#she} accidentally knocked over one of the ingredients."

698572703.text: #"The spilled ingredient contaminated the other substances, causing various chemicals to react with one another. A toxic mist rose up, making the Marechaussee Hunter and {M#his}{F#her} companion cough repeatedly, nausea causing their vision to swim."

698572802.text: #"The Marechaussee Hunter hurled the entire medicine box at the enemy. Just as {M#he}{F#she} anticipated, when the box shattered, the medicines within began to mix."

698572803.text: "Caught amidst the highly toxic mist, the enemy, already struck in the back of the head by the medicine box, grew dizzy and collapsed to the ground."

698572902.text: #"The Marechaussee Hunter hurled the entire medicine box at the enemy. Though it struck their head with pinpoint accuracy, the box proved far more durable than {M#he}{F#she} had anticipated."

698572903.text: "The medicine box did not shatter. The medicines inside did mix to create a toxic smoke, but the fumes remained tightly sealed within the box. Not a single wisp escaped."
